summary: Repository-level controls are implemented and locally verified, but production-like staging, external providers, review attestations, monitoring, restore/load drills, DNS, and the stacked roadmap merge are incomplete.

knownDefects.basis: No critical or high software defect is known from the completed local automated suite; GitHub CI and production-like staging evidence remain required.

launchRisks.risk: studacad.com DNS, TLS, and a production server deployment are not provisioned.
launchRisks.disposition: Deferred external setup; keep the public launch closed.

launchRisks.risk: No production malware scanner exists for tutor evidence.
launchRisks.disposition: Tutor evidence uploads fail closed; do not launch tutor onboarding until provisioned and tested.

launchRisks.risk: Meet, transactional email, and WhatsApp production accounts and credentials are not provisioned.
launchRisks.disposition: Provider copies and meeting provisioning remain unavailable; complete test-account staging drills before launch.

launchRisks.risk: Qualified legal, privacy, safeguarding, and accessibility review attestations are absent.
launchRisks.disposition: Do not represent the policies or operating model as professionally approved.

launchRisks.risk: Monitoring, alert routing, backup restore timing, load tests, and failure drills have not run against production-like staging.
launchRisks.disposition: Run and sign the evidence checklist before go-live.

launchRisks.risk: The ordered roadmap exists as a stacked draft pull-request chain and is not merged to the release branch.
launchRisks.disposition: Review and merge in order only after each check is green.

launchRisks.risk: Online payment-gateway checkout is intentionally deferred.
launchRisks.disposition: Keep online deposits unavailable; only audited verified offline deposits issue one credit per whole BWP.
